description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3040012491515 CONNECTING LINK,RIG: Line 0001 Qty 46 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0189 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
